translation_notes: The computed typed literal of the stratum: `g.add((tc, interchange_ontology.timeType, Literal(self.time_type.name, datatype=XSD.string)))` becomes `@graph g` + `+{ {time_component} aif:timeType {self.time_type.name}^^xsd:string }`. Literal('ON') and Literal('ON', datatype=XSD.string) are different terms in rdflib; the island keeps the datatype (mutant without ^^xsd:string fails the check).

The predicate interchange_ontology.timeType (a module of URIRef constants) is written `aif:timeType` with `@prefix aif:` (the module's NAMESPACE) inside the island; the other uses of interchange_ontology (the class argument of _make_aif_resource, the properties passed to add_literal) are ordinary Python arguments and stay as extracted. The mechanical draft's `xsd:gYear` etc. arguments are kept (a prefixed name evaluates to the URIRef).

add_literal (the three year/month/day triples) is a METHOD outside the region that writes `Literal(value)` then overwrites `_datatype`: not expressible as an island and not part of the region, so those calls stay.

Context shim (shim.py): interchange_ontology (generated constants), aifutils._make_aif_resource and LDCTimeComponent (__init__, add_literal), verbatim, because aida_interchange is not installed in the study venv.

Driver: four calls on fresh graphs (full date as strings with a pre-existing triple that must survive; integers; year only; type only), graph by isomorphism and the returned node by its place in the graph. `@graph g` adds the block's prefixes to the caller's graph (bindings, not triples); the check accepts bindings added by the translation.
optimization_notes: optimized.py: nothing to compress, identical to original.py. The single g.add and the three add_literal calls are already minimal, and a loop over (property, value, datatype) triples would not be shorter.

optimized.ldpy, written from optimized.py: `@graph g` + `+{ }` becomes one `+{ {time_component} aif:timeType {self.time_type.name}^^xsd:string }(g)` (call suffix, one line fewer). The interchange_ontology.LDCTimeComponent/year/month/day arguments become the prefixed names aif:LDCTimeComponent, aif:year, aif:month, aif:day, which are equal URIRefs under the `@prefix aif:` the header already declares (the module's NAMESPACE).
No exception to the symmetry rule. add_literal is a method outside the region, so it stays a Python call on both sides.
header_optimization_notes: LD Python: the whole `from rdflib import XSD, Literal, URIRef` line goes, and so does `from shim import interchange_ontology`, because the region now writes aif: and xsd: prefixed names. Both @prefix lines are used.
